notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
- Added a screen in the intro that displays the controls
- Added an end screen to replace the game simply quitting on its own
- Added a timer for the fireplace, it will now go out after 20 seconds in addition to it going out when you leave the room
- Reduced the frame cap to 30 frames per second

Thank you all for the support, keep being awesome!

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.06
notes.content:
- Reduced the probability of both the phone and the radio event, both now have a 1/18 chance of occurring, rather than a 1/10
- Set the game to have a fixed frame rate of 60 fps, this should fix the issue a few players have had with the game maxing out their GPU

notes.title: Hotfix 1.05
notes.content: - Fixed achievement issue, thank you everyone for your patience!
